# Changelog v0.12.0

Release Date: 2026-10-05

## 🔌 API

- Run a shared catalog on any client. (see PR [#4619](https://github.com/tetherto/qvac/pull/4619)) - See [API changes](./api.md)
- Auto-install addon platform packages for mobile bundles. (see PR [#4688](https://github.com/tetherto/qvac/pull/4688)) - See [API changes](./api.md)
- Bump npm consumers to @qvac/fabric 0.18.0. (see PR [#4733](https://github.com/tetherto/qvac/pull/4733)) - See [API changes](./api.md)

## 🧹 Chores

- Remove the inert runIdStrategy config field. (see PR [#4451](https://github.com/tetherto/qvac/pull/4451)) - See [breaking changes](./breaking.md)
